newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Cash Converters to list on ASX.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Cash Converters to list on ASX.

text.p: Second hand goods franchise chain Cash Converters International Ltd said it will make a compliance listing on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) on Wednesday.
The listing follows a listing of the company's units on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) in November 1995.
The company has 320 store franchises in 14 countries and expects to open in a further 17 countries by the end of 1997.
"Store numbers are forecast to grow to 405 by June 1997 and to 750 by June 1998," the company said.

The company said that to ensure ethical operation of its stores, it had introduced an identification system for the sellers of goods, with photos taken of sellers and details of all goods acquired passed onto the police.
"In Western Australia, full listings of purchases are downloaded by computer direct to police on a daily basis," the company said.
Cash Converters said it planned to open its first store in Asia this year.
"Success in Asia will lead to the opening up of another huge market," managing director Peter Cummins said in a statement.
Cash Converters posted a net profit of A$3.6 million in the year to June 30, 1996 and paid a fully-franked dividend of 3.9 cents a share.
